Title: Fix $env:($Name) dynamic assignment bug in setup-node-b.ps1
Description: In deploy/setup-node-b.ps1 Set-PersistentEnv, the line $env:($Name) = $Value is syntactically invalid for dynamic env var names. It silently assigns to a variable named '($Name)' in process scope instead of the intended env var. The machine-scope assignment above works correctly; only the in-process update fails. Fix: replace with Set-Item Env:\$Name $Value or [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($Name, $Value, 'Process').
